resources.string: Triple-tap gesture bar to lock rotation
Tap the center of the bottom gesture bar three times within %1$s seconds to run the selected rotation action.
Allow “Display over other apps” to receive bar taps and “Modify system settings” to change rotation. Enable each in Android settings.
Uses a small ordinary overlay, without accessibility access. Swipes, holds and multi-finger touches cancel the sequence. Other apps can hide overlays; Samsung navigation features need device testing.
Waiting for overlay/rotation permission or an unlocked screen
Listening for taps on the bottom gesture bar
Could not show the touch area. Check Display over other apps and gesture navigation.
Could not change rotation. Check Modify system settings access.
Triple-tap the center of the bottom gesture bar to run the rotation action.
Switch between locking the current direction and auto-rotate.
Turn to the direction you are holding the device, then lock again. Uses the same rotation settings as Shake to rotate; shaking does not need to be enabled.
Rotating to the device direction, then locking.
The three taps must finish within this time window. A longer window also makes accidental activation easier. Changing this setting resets the sequence.
Longest interval; easier to trigger accidentally

Adjust width and height from the bottom center of the screen. Larger areas can intercept app controls. Enable the feature and overlay permission to preview the actual area. Release each slider to save.
Tint the actual touch area while this option is enabled.
Two user-controlled permissions are used. Accessibility, Shizuku and wireless debugging are not needed for this feature.
Galaxy gesture navigation: Settings → Display → Navigation bar → Swipe gestures.
3. Enable the feature and try it
Return to GOAT, turn on the feature and choose an action. Tap the bottom bar center three times quickly. Use Show touch area and adjust width/height to find the target.
The two buttons open Android settings; they do not grant access automatically. Reopen GOAT after a force-stop to resume the feature.
Needed only to place the small touch area over the bar. Tap below → choose GOAT if a list appears → allow display over other apps.
Needed to toggle auto-rotation and lock the direction. Tap below and allow modifying system settings. If already granted for rotation, this step is complete.
Could not open Android settings. Open the permission from GOAT app info.
If Android blocks either permission, open GOAT app info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings and authenticate, then try again. This confirmation is controlled by Android; GOAT cannot skip it.
